note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are this entry's own words. 2 trophies are unconfirmed (id 44 and id 49) and are flagged as such.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. Plan on around 200 hours at difficulty 4/10. The route: play the story first (60-80 hours), then work the 100% Completion checklist (about 100 hours), then finish Strangers & Freaks and the cleanup (about 10 hours). There are no online trophies and one playthrough is enough, and free-roam continues after the story — but there is no mission replay, so do the possibly missable meditation in Chapter 1 while you are there.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game — follow the on-screen objectives through the opening. An automatic story trophy; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy, earned by finishing the chapter's final mission. It cannot be missed. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the one possibly missable step in the whole game (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy, earned by finishing the chapter's final mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy, earned by finishing the chapter's final mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy, earned by finishing the chapter's final mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The last story mission — finishing it earns the gold and rolls the credits. After the credits you return to free-roam, so nothing else in the game is locked behind the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — play it through to the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — play it through to the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — play it through to the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — play it through to the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — play it through to the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — play it through to the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, and progress made during the story already counts toward it. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 70 of 80 challenges are enough. Work through what is left on the list; nothing on it is missable. This is the hardest trophy and the last one most players earn.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and air time in vehicles, tracked by PSN. Chain them during free roam — jumps off ramps and long airtime count fastest, so keep a fast car near a jump and repeat it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Nine activity types are tracked — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, bowling and the rest. Sample one of each; the trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the ranges; gold each one. The range shows its gold threshold — repeat a challenge until the score clears it. The golds are not hard, just many.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations; win one race at each. The drone handles the same everywhere, so learning each course's line is the edge — fly the course once slowly, then race it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count — road, off-road and water races all qualify. Pick the short ones and work through the list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him — keep the line tension in the safe zone and reel in when he tires.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to its end — pick the shortest game on the machine and see it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand ends with this one. It is still available in free-roam after the story, so do it whenever the strand offers it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's mission strand ends with this one. It is still available in free-roam after the story, so do it whenever the strand offers it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's mission strand ends with this one. It is still available in free-roam after the story, so do it whenever the strand offers it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as encounters around the map; finish 8 full strands. They are not part of the 100% Completion checklist, so save them for the cleanup step after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's mission strand ends with this one. It is still available in free-roam after the story, so do it whenever the strand offers it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's mission strand ends with this one. It is still available in free-roam after the story, so do it whenever the strand offers it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in all. This is the one possibly missable trophy. The first meditation is offered in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept. Finish that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1; it cannot be done later. The other 17 spots are found across Leonida — meditate at each one as you find it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret points you at a specific rare animal; follow his lead, track it with the hunting prompts and take the shot cleanly.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set completes when every card in it is found. Collecting also feeds the 100% Completion checklist, so this overlaps with A Long Road.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK photo spots are scattered across the state; each first snap at a new location counts. Snap as you travel — the counter climbs on its own if you photograph new places instead of fast-travelling past them.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game's challenge list covers driving, combat and exploration — any 50 count. The 100% Completion checklist wants 70 of 80, so this comes along the way to A Long Road; skip the hardest ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and hide — a quiet alley, a parking garage or the water — until it clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in one run with your partner while holding the same wanted level — move fast between shops and do not let the level drop or clear between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 distinct vehicle models — a new model counts on first discovery. The WAiNK app's vehicle log helps you see what is still missing.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group clustered together and drop five before it ends — a tight group and a fast weapon are what make it possible.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport without taking a scheduled flight — drive or run out via a runway or a service exit instead of the terminal.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the army's tanks — get behind the wheel of one. They show up at military sites and in high wanted-level responses. This is our own reading of the official description; the exact trigger is not yet pinned down by a guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms tripped, no clerk reaching the button, and out before any response arrives.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each ending in a clean getaway. Vaults are part of the 100% Completion checklist too, so this overlaps with A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take the cash, and get away clean before the response catches you.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 named areas; visit each one and the counter ticks. The map's area names are the checklist — drive the borders and the gaps fill in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Nine gangs run illegal operations around the state; hit one operation per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. UNCONFIRMED: the exact spot and trigger are not pinned down yet. The description points to a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view — try the beachfront bars. Do not rely on this until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's front glass and out the other side — any vehicle showroom works; speed is the point.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish it — the trophy is about the follow-through, so complete the game rather than quitting early.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives no place or step — it is earned through a partner activity. Keep playing partner activities and it will come. This is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — make 500 profile actions, the choices and interactions the game counts. It accumulates through normal play; check the PSN counter to see where you stand.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx notes this is currently unknown, believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — the current best guess is failing something there once, then succeeding on the second try. Do not rely on this until a guide pins it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? CONFIRMED: the UFO appears on the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 02:00, while you are alone — flash your car headlights and wait. The spawn is somewhat random, so repeat on later nights until it shows.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. CONFIRMED: from a motorbike or bicycle, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in Vice City / Ocean Beach. Ride slow through a crowded stretch and kick as you pass — the 60-second window starts on the first kick.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; hand them to your contacts to launder until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shops count and the counter is cumulative — weapons, clothes, food and cars all add up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Eight garages are for sale around Leonida; buy every one. They are also useful storage once owned.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — any 10 distinct vehicles count.
